skillset.skill: 12s CT - 2800% Dark DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 40.
skillset.arts: 27000% Dark DMG (PHY). For 25s, increase Human allies' stats by 20% and own stats by an additional 20%.
skillset.truearts: 70000% Dark DMG (PHY). Increase allies' Arts by 30. For 25s, reduce enemies' PHY RES by 100%.
skillset.superarts: 230000% Dark DMG (PHY). Increase own Accuracy by 100% for the duration of Super Arts. Additionally for 20s, reduce enemies' DMG RES by 75%. If ownself is not affected by Status ailment(s), reduce enemies' DMG RES by 150% instead.

passive.ability1: At Start of Battle, increase next Skill's Arts UP by 100 instead and double next Super Arts' DMG Multiplier and Break Power. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: Increase own DMG by [1% x own ATK and DEF/ 100].
passive.ability3: Increase Dark allies' BE Output by 15%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Saito Hajime's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Saito Hajime's SP. Art is owned)
